title: Recording: Hard Times Are Over, Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him, Give Me Something by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 23 September 1980.

Lennon recorded harmony vocals for the album’s closing song, ‘Hard Times Are Over’. Ono then added more lead vocals to ‘Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him’ and ‘Give Me Something’.
